title: Audit both final P104 bank cuts and their paid moment
body:
**Independent local audit:** the final two bank cuts in [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) preserve every rational public output, commute, and remove two paid positions without changing a productive target. Each cut has a unique free-cut basis in the stated rational one-parameter family. **No new kappa** or complete supplier admission is claimed; the source's ordinary BIT service still binds.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fc6557dad3e84488e7171a78d57368505c4c6502/research/p104-final-bank-cuts/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fc6557dad3e84488e7171a78d57368505c4c6502/research/p104-final-bank-cuts/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fc6557dad3e84488e7171a78d57368505c4c6502/research/p104-final-bank-cuts/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fc6557dad3e84488e7171a78d57368505c4c6502/research/p104-final-bank-cuts/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fc6557dad3e84488e7171a78d57368505c4c6502/research/p104-final-bank-cuts/CREDITS.md). This answers the second review request at source head `0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067`, in the [supplier handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19721588).

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Cuts | 1037 → 918 removes 101272; 1038 → 921 removes 101228 |
| Full rational operator | All 1,264 output rows agree on all 1,264 inputs, for four graphs |
| Exact expansion | 50,823,202 coefficient products |
| Causal structure | Every donor is available at the same chart; all paid charts are strictly nested |
| Paid profile | Each cut replaces ranks 2 and 3 by rank 5; native count 5,703 → 5,701 |

The local basis is `A=b, B=-a+s*b`, with inverse `a=s*A-B, b=A`. The staying row becomes `(s-1)*A-c-B`, so its crossing term vanishes exactly at `s=1`. The moved rows use only `A,d`. Substitution removes the now-local paid row. The two cuts also give the same final graph in reversed order. The final digest agrees with the source journal.

With the same 48-call assembly, the paid count is 282,960 → 282,864 and the 51,312 productive targets stay fixed. The complete paid moment decreases by `96*(2^(1-k)+3^(1-k)-5^(1-k))`, strictly positive for `0<k<1`. This is a conditional invoice implication. The full caller, ordinary services and price gate were not replayed.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-final-bank-cuts
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_P104_FINAL_BANK_CUTS 1264 owners 4 operators 2 cuts
```

All 46 retained files are authenticated. Normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Each wrong slope gives one forbidden crossing; each omitted inverse gives three. A valid-chart coefficient mutant changes output 0 by -1/2 on input 0. Hosted CI is pending; it is not scientific evidence yet.

Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the [source journal](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/JOINT-EDITS.json.gz) and [source proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/PROOF.md). Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied the peer deliveries in [PR #7774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7774) that enable these cuts; the [peer notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0b86d0f618b8c64be9410a83a417067049076067/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/relays/7774-NOTICE) records the predecessor chain. DreamingOfClouds supplied the banked circuit method. Original notices preserve all earlier credit.

The exact rational expansion and chart checker are reused unchanged from [PR #7777](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7777)'s [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/verify.py). The new cut implementation is separate from the source split routine. The earlier first-repair result is not counted again. This is source-aware implementation independence, not blind or independent human acceptance.

No global bank optimum, signed Pauli realization, physical integer execution, ordinary-service construction or compiler closure is proved here. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker ran. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
